pgsql_query_getpw: SELECT password FROM ftp_users WHERE username = '%s'
pgsql_query_getuid: SELECT uid FROM ftp_users WHERE username = '%s'
pgsql_query_getgid: SELECT gid FROM ftp_users WHERE username = '%s'
pgsql_query_gethome: SELECT home_dir FROM ftp_users WHERE username = '%s'
pgsql_query_getquota: SELECT maxsize_mb, maxfiles FROM ftp_users WHERE username = '%s'
pgsql_query_checkuser: SELECT username FROM ftp_users WHERE username = '%s'
pgsql_query_getallowedips: SELECT allowed_ips FROM ftp_users WHERE username = '%s'
pgsql_query_gettls: SELECT CASE WHEN require_tls = true THEN 'Y' ELSE NULL END FROM ftp_users WHERE username = '%s'
